harness_repair.diagnosis: This is a second, independent sandbox on the same calendar date hitting the identical, already-documented gap recorded in docs/design/autotrain-cycle-c2-agentv-missing-infra-failure.json (commit 72fdffaf054efee2f3dccc4bab0ca97c111072e1, #1360): a fresh checkout never ran `npm ci` at the repo root, so node_modules/@agentv/core was missing and evaluate_model.py --ship-gates crashed in publish_model_evaluation before producing a scoreboard for either arm.
